summary: Respect product probabilities and ranged quantities when checking science acquisition.
details: Empty or malformed shared probability intervals no longer establish a positive product witness. Both independent and shared rolls must permit output.
Possible baseline item output includes finite extra item fractions at zero base quantity and the native clamp of a ranged maximum to its minimum. Extra item counts do not establish fluid output.

This corrects structural acquisition only. Productivity permissions, ownership and return-cone admission retain their separate guards; shared and fractional routes remain withheld from productivity admission.
Modern product fields are checked against the selected platform's declared native contract; an undeclared fractional field cannot create a legacy acquisition witness.

Schema-2 canonical recipe facts retain a synthesized effective probability on older targets. Capability gating checks their authored declaration separately, preserving ordinary legacy acquisition and rejecting genuinely foreign fields without changing canonical fact bytes.

The consumed researchability fixture passes 204 assertions, including 31 product cases. The real recipe-source fixture passes 30 assertions, including 20 canonical product cases against actual F210/F200/F110/F100 target contracts. Native package, machine, save and ecosystem qualification remains pending.
